mcq_drop.why: obscure projection-percentage trivia beyond PYQ depth

pyq_bad.why: suspect key: equal birth/death rates with no migration = zero population growth

patterns: APPSC asks demographic dividend at definitional level: working-age group 15-64, its share (~62.9%), life expectancy at Independence (~32).
Other PSCs recur on stage order of demographic transition, dependency ratio meaning, IMR/MMR definitions and State extremes (Kerala lowest IMR).
Determinants of fertility (urbanisation, literacy) asked as short statement items.
App leans on SRS 2024 and RBI State typology/projections which PYQs never test; PYQs prefer Census-based ratios.
